description: AWS coverage ledger (specs/spec-aws-core-coverage-ledger.md): every CloudFormation resource type, with what aws_core does with it. Generated by `python -m tap_plugin.aws_core.ledger build`; do not edit by hand. Facts are derived from the CloudFormation schema bundle and botocore; classifications are the reviewed decisions in decisions.json.
